description: DiligenceOps: submit incident claims about duration, scope, cause and resolution and the timeline, status updates or postmortem offered for them. The signed report marks each claim supported, contradicted or never mentioned, comparing durations in any unit, clock times, regions and affected shares, and checks a stated duration and start or resolution time against the timeline the evidence gives, with quotes. POST /api/incident-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-vendor-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

claims.description: Incident claims about duration, scope, cause and resolution, for example "The outage lasted 45 minutes and affected only EU customers; a bad deploy caused it and a rollback resolved it". As one text, which is split into parts at sentences, semicolons, commas and joining words, or as a list of up to 50 parts.

evidence.description: The incident timeline, status page updates, postmortem or other evidence. As text, or up to 200 excerpts as {source, text}. Up to 256 KB in all.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

name: wever_incident-evidence-check
title: Incident evidence check
